packets.exact_fragment: These are controlled substances, obtained by private prescription. We comply with the legal process for issuing import licences. Each licence covers individual importation or shipment of CBPM. Upon receipt of your import licence you then forward the licence to your pharmacy who require this to send you the shipment. The law in place in Guernsey allows local doctors to prescribe products privately.

packets.exact_fragment: The legal purchase age for cannabis in Maryland is 21 or older. Licensed dispensaries are the only place to legally buy cannabis in Maryland. Cannabis products may be purchased from licensed dispensaries. A person may purchase cannabis or cannabis products from a licensed dispensary if they display a government-issued photo ID that demonstrates they are 21 years or older.
packets.review_summary: Direct Maryland Cannabis Administration adult-use FAQ review: official Maryland.gov/MCA ownership, adult-use conditions and lawful licensed-dispensary purchase route were visibly rendered.

packets.exact_fragment: Depuis le 27 mars 2024, aucun nouveau patient ne peut entrer dans l'expérimentation. Seuls les patients inclus dans l’expérimentation avant cette date peuvent continuer à bénéficier de prescriptions et délivrances de médicaments à base de cannabis.
packets.review_summary: Direct Service-Public/DILA review: current transition page visibly states that patients already included before 27 March 2024 continue to receive cannabis-medicine prescriptions and dispensations; this is a restricted continuity route, not new enrolment.

packets.exact_fragment: Depuis le 1er janvier 2025, la formation reste disponible et obligatoire pour un nouveau professionnel de santé qui souhaite suivre un patient déjà traité.
